META_DESCRIPTION: Explore how regular investing and compound interest can grow over time.
HEADER_CURIOSITY_ARIA: A note about your financial future
SUMMARY_EMPTY: Enter your details to see your projection.
CHART_ARIA: Investment growth chart. Hover or move across the chart to inspect each month.
CHART_ARIA_PROJECTION: A dashed line shows a possible future projection.
CHART_PLACEHOLDER: Your investment timeline will appear here.
DID_YOU_KNOW_EMPTY: Regular deposits give each contribution a chance to earn interest in the months that follow.
INSIGHT_PROJECTION_COPY: Stay invested for {duration} more {unit} and your balance could grow by {percent}%, reaching {value}.
INSIGHT_RATE_COPY: A monthly rate of {monthly}% is credited every month. Its effective yearly equivalent is {annual}%.
INSIGHT_RATE_ANNUAL_COPY: Your {annual}% annual rate is credited once every twelve months; monthly deposits arrive between those yearly ticks.
INSIGHT_COMPOUND_COPY: About {percent}% of your ending balance comes from estimated interest: {interest} earned as the deposits compound.
INSIGHT_TIME_COPY: Regular deposits give each contribution a chance to earn interest in the months that follow.
HOW_INTRO: A monthly contribution meets a rate that credits interest at its chosen pace.
HOW_STEP_ONE_COPY: Monthly income is added after an interest tick, so the newest deposit waits until the next one.
HOW_FORMULA_CONTRIBUTION_NOTE: An annual income input is divided into twelve monthly deposits.
HOW_STEP_TWO_COPY: A monthly rate compounds every month. An annual rate compounds every twelve months.
HOW_FORMULA_RATE_NOTE: x is the entered percentage, r is its decimal form; p = 1 for monthly rates and p = 12 for annual rates.
HOW_STEP_THREE_COPY: The balance grows at the selected rate tick, then this month's deposit is added.
HOW_FORMULA_BALANCE_NOTE: If m is not an interest tick, Bₘ = Bₘ₋₁ + C. The last deposit earns no future tick.
HOW_STEP_FOUR_COPY: Every deposit compounds only for the interest ticks that happen after it.
HOW_FORMULA_TOTAL_NOTE: q(m) counts the later interest ticks; a final deposit has q(N) = 0.
HOW_FOOTNOTE: Growth compares estimated interest with total contributions. Taxes, fees, inflation, and changing returns are not included.
FOOTER_NOTE: A simple way to picture the road ahead.
ERROR_INVALID_INCOME: Enter an income amount greater than zero.
ERROR_INVALID_RATE: Enter a valid interest rate of zero or more.
ERROR_INVALID_INTEREST_PERIOD: Choose whether the interest rate is monthly or yearly.
ERROR_INVALID_DURATION: Enter a whole-number duration greater than zero.
ERROR_INVALID_DURATION_UNIT: Choose whether the duration is measured in months or years.
ERROR_INVALID_PROJECTION: Choose a future projection between 2 and 10 months or years.
ERROR_PROJECTION_LIMIT: There is not enough room within the 100-year limit for this projection.
ERROR_DURATION_LIMIT: The maximum projection period is 100 years.
ERROR_VALUES_TOO_LARGE: These values are too large to calculate.
ERROR_RESULT_TOO_LARGE: The result is beyond the numeric range. Try a lower rate or shorter duration.
ERROR_NETWORK: Could not connect to the server. Please try again.
